title: CDC Food Safety: 10 Dangerous Mistakes (2023)
description: CDC's 2023 fact sheet describing ten common food-handling mistakes. The original PDF retains its illustrations; a searchable text companion is included. The factsheet links to more detailed material that is not included in this pack and is not a comprehensive food-preservation, canning, or power-outage guide. Check current official guidance when available.
